fields.label: Bezeichnung
fields.description: Anzeigename dieser Eigenen Kollektion, z.B. 'Sale 2026', 'Bestseller', 'Outdoor & Wasserdicht'.

fields.label: Kurzname (Slug)
fields.description: Internal identifier (Frappe document name). Made unique with the storefront suffix. Editable later.

fields.label: Backend-Handle (optional)
fields.description: Optional: handle / SEO URL in the shop (e.g. Medusa category handle, Shopware seoUrl). When empty, the slug is used. Set this for a shorter URL in the shop.

fields.label: Aktiv (am Cron-Sync teilnehmen)
fields.description: Active: the collection is updated automatically by the scheduled sync (cron) whenever rule results change. Inactive: the collection is maintained only via the 'Sync now' button.

fields.label: Parent collection (optional)
fields.description: Optional: parent collection for nested categories (only on backends that support it).

fields.label: Sortier-Reihenfolge
fields.description: Lower values rank higher. Decides which collection 'wins' a main category on conflicts.

fields.label: Leere Kollektion erlauben
fields.description: When disabled (default): if the rules produce no items, the backend category isn't created and a warning appears. Enable to create empty collections too.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional description used in the shop and for SEO.

fields.label: Rules
fields.description: Define which items fall into this collection automatically. Each row is a rule — e.g. 'Item group is Shoes' or 'Brand contains Nike'.

fields.label: Rule combinator
fields.description: AND requires every rule to match. OR requires one. OR-groups are supported via the 'OR Group' column (rows sharing the same OR-group number are OR-combined; the groups themselves combine via this combinator).

fields.label: Sync-Ziele (pro Storefront)
fields.description: Which shops/storefronts this collection is synced to. One row per storefront.

fields.label: Statistik (informativ)
fields.description: Read-only information from the last rule resolution.

fields.label: Item count (last resolved)
fields.description: Number of items the rules captured on the last sync.

fields.label: Last resolved (informational)
fields.description: Timestamp of the last rule run.
